question: A and B can complete a piece of work in 20 days, B and C can complete the same piece of work in 12 days, while C and A can do it in 15 days. In how many days can A, B, and C together complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B can complete a piece of work in 20 days

B and C can complete the same piece of work in 12 days

C and A can complete the same piece of work in 15 days

**Formula used:**

If A and B can complete work in x days, B and C in y days, and C and A in z days, then

1/x + 1/y + 1/z = 2(1/A + 1/B + 1/C)
